tasks.title: Atomic fingerprint claim for setup-pause notifications (CAS + reset + reorder)
tasks.objective: Refine the recoverable claim. P2-2: markJobSetupNotified RETURNS the notify_claim_at it set as a token (null if lost); confirmJobSetupNotified and clearJobSetupNotified take the token and add WHERE notify_claim_at=token, so a stale claimant cannot confirm/clear a successor claim. Thread it through port+impls+execution-readiness. P2-1: document in code + 0117/spec that delivery is exactly-once normally, at-least-once across a send-confirm crash. Update tests for the token signatures.
acceptance_criteria: markJobSetupNotified is an atomic CAS claim; notifyJobSetupRequired claims before send; loser delivers nothing; failed delivery clears the claim; concurrent creation+run for one fingerprint yields exactly one card and one event; silent/suppressed/already-notified unchanged.
verify_commands: npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts apps/core/test/unit/application apps/core/test/unit/jobs apps/core/test/unit/runner

required_tests.id: notifyJobSetupRequired > concurrent creation and run notifications deliver exactly one card and one event
required_tests.command: VITEST_JUNIT=1 FORGE_TEST_ID={id} npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts {path} --outputFile {report}

tasks.reviewer_focus: atomic claim-before-send; loser no-ops (no card/no event); clear-on-failure retryability; silent/already-notified unchanged; shared notifier callers (scheduler/recovery/creation) all correct.
